scope: Standalone source and item32px/crop compositing only; not actual game inventory acceptance

findings.surveyLens: Complete circular retaining barrel with alloy/bronze rim and curved dark blue-grey optical glass; small cool reflected highlight is not a powered light. No whole machine, eye or crystal ball.
findings.antennaWire: Exposed copper metallic coil with two attached bent ends and restrained verdigris.32px shows the warm coiled silhouette/open centre and ends; not a rope or gold jewellery ring.
findings.lightLegFrame: One articulated narrow grey alloy leg with triangular cutouts, hinge caps, lower strut and attached foot flange. Readable at32px; actual1x2/32x64 footprint preserves more joint structure. Not bone/wood, gun or whole tripod.
findings.thermalSensor: Compact rectangular dark ceramic/glass aperture module with metal housing, vent ribs and lower contact tabs. Distinct from round survey lens and power cell; unpowered/no heat-map screen.
findings.materialMatch: Grey alloy and restrained bronze/black glass follow the own Surveyor body and own industrial reference palette. Copper remains visibly distinct from alloy.
findings.cropAndAlpha: Complete items including wire ends/mount/foot/contacts, no visible cut silhouette or neighbouring item. Dark/light/black canvas composites preserve transparent background without floor/shadow/backdrop baked in.
findings.nativeFit: 32px thumbnail and actual1x1/1x2 footprints use min(box.w/frame.w,box.h/frame.h), matching the inspected ItemIcon.vue fit formula; no per-icon fake stretch. Main component itself was not loaded.
findings.limits: Fine scratch/barb detail does not all survive16/32px. Actual inventory tooltip/drag/grid/crafting/salvage scene after parent integration not tested.
